title: Nugget Mod
description: You can Shoot Nuggets with a Nugget Gun ( CHICKEN NUGGET )
body:
Nugget mod is a mod Inspired by a Minecraft Movie with the Nugget Gun, that Henry Made, but it is Still in Alpha. The mod was made in a Hour And the Things you can get with Mod

Raw Nugget - It is a Raw Nugget, that you can cook into a Full Nugget. Nugget - Is the Cooked Version of the Nugget, that you can Eat Nugget Armor - Is a Random thing i Made up to not be just Nugget and a Nugget Gun. Nugget Gun - Thing that you can Shoot Cooked Nuggets at Anything, and it has Good Damage too.

I hope you Enjoy the Mod.

Also, the Mod will be updated at random times. I dont know when.
